papers.title: SIC-POVM d=2: Symmetric Informationally Complete Measurements
papers.description: Introduces the SIC-POVM framework for d=2 quantum systems, forming the measurement backbone of the P31 quantum visualizations.

papers.title: Posner Molecule: Quantum Coherence in Calcium Phosphate Nanoclusters
papers.description: Explores quantum coherence effects in Posner molecules, relevant to neural signal processing and the P31 quantum biology models.

papers.title: K₄ Planar Graph: Maxwell Rigidity and Topological Constraints
papers.description: Formalizes Maxwell rigidity conditions for K₄ planar graphs, underpinning the mesh topology visualizations.

papers.title: Von Neumann Entropy in Finite-Dimensional Quantum Systems
papers.description: Derives entropy bounds for finite-dimensional systems, used in the P31 rate-distortion and entropy visualizations.

papers.title: Morphogenetic Field: Algebraic Geometry of Care Networks
papers.description: Models care networks as morphogenetic fields using algebraic geometry, providing the mathematical foundation for the family mesh.

papers.title: Bandit Arms: Regret Bounds for Adaptive Care Allocation
papers.description: Multi-armed bandit formulations for adaptive resource allocation in care systems, implemented in the Genesis Spark worker.

papers.title: Wye-Delta Morphism: Graph Transformation in Care Topologies
papers.description: Wye-delta transformations applied to care network topologies, enabling dynamic mesh reconfiguration.

papers.title: Ricci Curvature of Discrete Care Graphs
papers.description: Computes Ricci curvature on discrete graphs representing care relationships, identifying structural resilience.

papers.title: Maxwell Rigidity: Conditions for Isostatic Rigidity in Graphs
papers.description: Establishes necessary and sufficient conditions for isostatic rigidity in finite graphs, applied to mesh validation.

papers.title: SIC-POVM Tomography: Efficient Quantum State Reconstruction
papers.description: Presents efficient tomography algorithms using SIC-POVM measurements, reducing reconstruction complexity.

papers.title: Rate-Distortion Theory for Care Communication Channels
papers.description: Applies rate-distortion theory to care communication, optimizing information flow in family mesh networks.

papers.title: Kuramoto Model for Synchronization in Care Networks
papers.description: Kuramoto synchronization models applied to care network dynamics, explaining emergent coherence in family meshes.
